transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I publish the final outage calendar, I need to hear from the facilities and signal leads on any current constraints you're dealing with. We've got preventive maintenance due at both the water treatment plant and the communications annex over the next two workdays, and we only have one maintenance crew available — so the two outages can't overlap. Please let me know what you're working with so I can schedule this properly.

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard constraint on the water treatment plant maintenance. I confirmed this morning that the water-treatment contractor is available only Tuesday from 0900 to 1100. The contractor confirmation is sitting in the facilities email but hasn't been entered on the battalion maintenance calendar yet.
